cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you wear my ribbon or Nina's for the chess club election?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Keep us both as friends. Which one do you want as chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's the vote. Tell me which ribbon you'll wear then; I'll happily lend you the other one today.

mechanism: A corrects friendship and scheduling answers as irrelevant to electoral allegiance, demanding the ribbon that will signal B chosen chair on voting day.
confusable: D57 seeks a title for A; D58 requires B to choose between competing people or claims.
comparison: Workshop alternative forces proposal sponsorship; election alternative turns alternating ribbons into a decisive-day commitment.
seedUse: Ribbons, Nina, friendship and tomorrow vote derive from D58-b; S03 adds precise election-versus-social corrections.
